architecture.text: pgvector is written in C and executes as an extension within PostgreSQL (`CREATE EXTENSION vector;`). It introduces custom data types (`vector`, `halfvec`, `bit`, `sparsevec`), custom distance operators, and index methods like HNSW and IVFFlat that run inside standard Postgres transaction and query execution frameworks.
